notable_absence.finding: Unlike get-started-explore.md's equivalent role/user examples (same batch), this page's Example 3 (Add a Sync Gateway Role) and Example 4 (Add a Sync Gateway User) JSON bodies use literal, unresolved placeholder text instead of real scope/collection names - `"scopename": {"collection_name" {admin_channels": [...]}}` - which is not even syntactically valid JSON (missing colon after `"collection_name"`, missing opening quote before `admin_channels`). No scopedToKeyspace relation could be extracted here as a result, in contrast to get-started-explore.json's clean `inventory`/`hotel` scoping. This looks like unfinished/stale content predating the scopes-and-collections feature rather than a deliberate simplification.

cross_component_finding: This page (front-matter dated 2026-03-27, edit URL pointing at release/4.0, titled 'Verify a Sync Gateway Install' and self-described as 'Step 4') substantially duplicates get-started-configure.md (front-matter dated 2026-08-17, release/4.1, titled 'Configure a Sync Gateway Install', also self-described as 'Step 3') - identical bootstrap config example and 'Connect to Sync Gateway' section - and also duplicates get-started-explore.md's CRUD-cycle walkthrough, but with the malformed JSON and un-scoped database noted above. Combined with the numbering clash (both this page and get-started-explore.md claim to be 'Step 4' of the same four-step sequence, and this page's own in-page step nav still lists itself as '[Verify]' rather than '[Configure]'/'[Explore]'), this is strong evidence get-started-verify-install.md is a superseded 4.0-era page that the 4.1 docs split into get-started-configure.md + get-started-explore.md without removing the original - a docs-issue candidate for round 29's reconciliation (not filed here per the no-cross-batch-reconciliation rule, but flagged in all three overlapping records this round).
